Definition: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be behind, follow after, pursue, persecute, run after; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to pursue, put to flight, chase, dog, attend closely upon; 1a2) to persecute, harass (fig); 1a3) to follow after, aim to secure (fig); 1a4) to run after (a bribe) (fig); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be pursued; 1b2) one pursued (participle); 1c) (Piel) to pursue ardently, aim eagerly to secure, pursue; 1d) (Pual) to be pursued, be chased away; 1e) (Hiphil) to pursue, chase
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
